text:
If the madman never had hope, nor the wise man despair, from what accidents do I lose my life today? What feeling reaches my reason?


Who changes my memory so I forget what I seek? I see it dreaming, and wake without sleeping: evil weighs and good balances equally.


I listen deaf and recognize blind; rest working and speak mute; humbly wait and proudly ask.


If this unrest is not love, I doubt I can know what ends me: no one lives more surrendered to himself.

translation.title: If the Madman Never Had Hope
